subject: Geografia
description_pt: Comparar impactos das atividades econômicas urbanas e rurais sobre o ambiente físico natural, assim como os riscos provenientes do uso de ferramentas e máquinas.

components.description_pt: Comparar os impactos ambientais das atividades econômicas urbanas no ambiente físico natural
components.description_en: Compare the environmental impacts of urban economic activities on the natural physical environment
components.cc_component_description: Compare the environmental effects of human activities with efforts to mitigate those effects

components.description_pt: Identificar riscos ao ambiente natural originários do uso de ferramentas e maquinário em atividades econômicas
components.description_en: Identify risks to the natural environment arising from the use of tools and machinery in economic activities
components.cc_component_description: Explain how human use of natural resources for energy affects the environment

cc_matches.description: Obtain and combine information to describe that energy and fuels are derived from natural resources and their uses affect the environment.

Human activities in agriculture, industry, and everyday life have had major effects on the land, vegetation, streams, ocean, air, and even outer space. But individuals and communities are doing things to help protect Earth’s resources and environments.
